name: Create Task
summary: Create a new Harbor task for evaluating agents. Use when the user wants to scaffold, build, or design a new task, benchmark problem, or eval. Guides through instruction writing, environment setup, verifier design (pytest vs Reward Kit vs custom), and solution scripting.

name: Rewardkit
summary: Write Harbor task verifiers using Reward Kit. Use when creating or editing a task's tests/ directory, adding grading criteria, setting up LLM/agent judges, or designing verifiers that produce a reward score.
